# Extract the scores for the two players
stricker_score = df[df['player'] == 'steve stricker']['score'].iloc[0]
mickelson_score = df[df['player'] == 'phil mickelson']['score'].iloc[0]

# Parse the scores to get the total numeric value
# The score column format is e.g., "70 + 69 = 139", we need the total after "="
stricker_total = int(stricker_score.split('=')[-1].strip())
mickelson_total = int(mickelson_score.split('=')[-1].strip())

# Check if Stricker's score is lower than Mickelson's
# Also verify Stricker's country is Scotland (as per the claim)
stricker_country = df[df['player'] == 'steve stricker']['country'].iloc[0]
answer = (stricker_country == 'scotland') and (stricker_total < mickelson_total)
